# GitHub Actions workflows

Every workflow file in this folder, with its trigger, purpose, and status. Status is from `gh workflow list --all` (checked 2026-10-27).

The autotest chain runs in two steps. A `Feature` issue that gets the `Run TA creation workflow` label produces an `Autotests` issue (`openai-create-autotest-request.yml`). A `Task` issue with the `Autotests` and `Run TA creation workflow` labels produces a PR with the Playwright spec (`claude-implement-autotests.yml`).

The three AI workflows (`claude-review.yml`, `openai-create-autotest-request.yml`, `claude-implement-autotests.yml`) run in the `ai-workflows` environment, which holds the AI secrets and requires a reviewer to approve each run. Approve a run only when you started it, for example by adding the label. If the PR has the `workflows-changed` label, read its changes to CI workflows and agent configuration first. For the autotest workflows, read the issue text first, because it goes into the prompt. An approval request that you did not start is a warning sign: do not approve it.

Results go to code scanning.                                                                                                                                                                                 | active                                                                                                                                                                              | The language matrix is in the file. The file header asks maintainers to check it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `danger.yml` (Danger)                                                 | `pull_request_target` to `master` and `release/**`: opened, edited, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled                         | Runs Danger with `dangerfile.ts`: PR title, branch name, linked issue, size, memory-bank line, requested reviewers, and the PR-type contract (rules in `scripts/pr-checks.mjs`). Posts one comment and fails the job on a fail.    | active                                                                                                                                                                              | `pull_request_target` lets the token comment on fork PRs. PRs from forks run on `ubuntu-latest`. A curl step checks that sonar.epam.com is reachable first.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| `claude-review.yml` (Claude PR Review)                                | `pull_request` `labeled`. The job runs only if the PR has the `Run Claude Review` label and its title does not contain `Autotests`.   | Runs `claude-code-action` with `/review-pr` on the PR, using `claude-opus-5-5`. It can post inline review comments.                                                                                                                | active                                                                                                                                                                              | The prompt passes `REPO` and `PR_NUMBER` as text. The `/review-pr` skill (`.agents/skills/review-pr`) reads them from its arguments. Verified in CI on PR #12487: the skill loads, posts inline findings, and posts the brief as one top-level comment. On a branch older than the skills restructure, the skill did not load: the action restores `.claude` from `master`, but `.agents` came from the stale PR checkout, so the `review-pr` symlink was broken and the run ended green with no comment. The `Align agent skills with master` step replaces `.agents` with master's copy before the action runs, and `claude_args` allows the `gh pr view/diff/comment` and `gh issue view` commands the skill needs. |
| `openai-create-autotest-request.yml` (OpenAI Create Autotest Request) | `issues` `labeled`. The job runs only for the `Run TA creation workflow` label on a `Feature` issue. | Calls OpenAI `gpt-4o` for a markdown checklist of test scenarios. Creates an `Autotests` issue with only the checklist lines of the answer, and comments the link on the feature issue. | active | Needs the `OPENAI_API_KEY` secret. The checklist goes into the prompt of `claude-implement-autotests.yml`, so only checklist lines are copied. |
| `claude-implement-autotests.yml` (Claude Implement Autotests) | `issues` `labeled`. The job runs only when the added label is `Run TA creation workflow` and the issue is a `Task` issue with the `Autotests` label. | Takes the feature issue from the first link under `Source task(s):` and builds the spec file name `<featureID>-<Feature-Name>.spec.ts` from it. Takes the `Version` line of the comment block from the feature issue milestone, without `-rc.N`. Runs Claude Code with the `generate-autotests` skill to write the Playwright spec, with one test, or a `test.skip` with a reason, for each checklist item. Claude can read the repository and write files under `ketcher-autotests/` only; it cannot run commands, commit, or push. The model comes from the `AUTOTEST_MODEL` repository variable, `claude-sonnet-5-5` when it is unset. Before Claude runs, the job checks the `autotests/<issue number>` branch: an open PR on it stops the job with an error that names the PR, and a branch left from a closed PR is replaced at the push with `--force-with-lease` against the commit seen at the start of the job. After Claude, `scripts/autotests/move-test-data.mjs` moves every test-data path of the spec into the feature folder (`tests/test-data/<Format>/[Chromium-popup/]<spec name>/`): it copies files from other folders there and rewrites the paths. The workflow then commits to that branch, pushes it, opens a PR to `master` with `Closes #N`, the number of checklist items and tests, the copied test-data files, and the data paths that the spec builds from variables (to check by hand), and comments the PR link on the issue. | active | The issue text goes into the prompt, so read it before adding the label. Claude does not run the spec. CI runs on the PR only after a user with write access clicks "Approve workflows to run" on it. The job stops with an error when the issue has no checklist, has no feature link, the feature issue has no release milestone, an open PR uses the `autotests/<issue number>` branch, or Claude changes nothing under `ketcher-autotests/`. |
| `copilot-setup-steps.yml` (Copilot Setup Steps) | `workflow_dispatch`, and `push` and `pull_request` that change this file. The Copilot coding agent also runs it before each task, from the default branch. | Checks out the repository, sets up Node.js 24.20.0, runs `npm ci` and `npm run build:packages`. The job must be called `copilot-setup-steps`, or Copilot does not use it. | active | Copilot's pre-push hook and unit tests need the built packages (the generated KET schema and the built `ketcher-core`). Only `steps`, `permissions`, `runs-on`, `services`, `snapshot` and `timeout-minutes` (at most 59) of the job are used by Copilot. The setup steps and Copilot's work run in one Actions job, so `timeout-minutes` limits the whole session, not only the setup. It is set to 59: with 30, longer sessions were cancelled (#12865). |
| `update-autotest-snapshots.yml` (Update Autotest Snapshots) | `pull_request` `labeled`. The job runs only for the `Update snapshots` label on a PR from this repository. | Runs the spec files the PR changes in the CI Playwright container (`mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-jammy`) with `--update-snapshots=missing`, commits only the new PNG baselines under `ketcher-autotests/tests/specs/**-snapshots/` and the new expected files that the specs write under `ketcher-autotests/tests/test-data/` (the export formats of `verifyFileExport`) to the PR branch, starts the matching Playwright test runs on the branch, and removes the label. | active | The job runs the spec code, so read the specs before adding the label. Check each new image and expected file in the PR diff: a wrong state becomes the baseline. Existing baselines and expected files are not changed. The run that creates the images has no secrets and read-only access; a separate job commits them. |
| `label-workflow-changes.yml` (Label workflow changes) | `pull_request_target`: opened, synchronize, reopened | Adds the `workflows-changed` label to a PR that changes `.github/`, `.claude/`, `.agents/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` or `.mcp.json` (rules in `.github/labeler.yml`). Removes it when those changes are reverted. | active | Runs this file and `.github/labeler.yml` from the base branch, so a PR cannot turn off its own check. It does not check out PR code and uses no secrets. The first PR that adds it cannot test it, because `pull_request_target` uses the base branch. |
